offers_products.reason: Manufactures engineered pumps, valves, connectors, brake pads, energy absorption components and aerospace actuators across three segments.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly manufactured components; repair stations and lifecycle support are secondary to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells components to industrial, automotive, rail, aerospace and energy businesses; no direct household buyers among main customers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are automakers, defense contractors, chemical, oil and gas, and food manufacturers buying pumps, connectors and brake components.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largely repeat orders of components, brake pads, replacement pumps and aftermarket parts from the same OEM and industrial customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand tied to automotive production, industrial capex, and oil and gas and chemical investment, which can be postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly components, connectors, brake pads, valves and pumps sold in frequent, repeat orders; some larger process systems are a minority.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured engineered components and products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large automakers, rail and aerospace OEMs, defense contractors, and major oil, gas and chemical companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs many global manufacturing plants for pumps, valves, connectors and friction components, requiring ongoing capital investment.

notes: Segment mix (pumps, brake components, connectors) is judged from general knowledge of ITT.
